recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current FHIR source already satisfies the final FHIR-7761 decision as edited by its companion issues and as later refactored for R5 relationship terminology; no follow-up source work is recommended for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-7761 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 ConceptMap issue asking $translate to allow multiple outcomes with distinct codings; its final resolution said to see FHIR-7760 and FHIR-7457 and to endorse the edited form.
initial_application: No discovered commit explicitly names FHIR-7761, but the referenced edit family was applied in historical source. Commit b1e826a4b83ef9617115bf221f0df040c5e39951 (svn revision 5518) changed the former single translate.outcome output into repeatable translate.match with nested equivalence/concept/product parts for FHIR-7457, while FHIR-7760 supplied the related dependency/product parameter shape. FHIR-9131 later corrected the response example from outcome to match.
additional_context: ConceptMap is active in source/fhir.ini and source/conceptmap/list-ConceptMap-operations.xml points to OperationDefinition/ConceptMap-translate, so the inspected operation definition is in build scope. Later Published vocabulary decisions FHIR-22632 and FHIR-22636 renamed ConceptMap and $translate equivalence terminology to relationship, explaining why current source uses match.relationship rather than match.equivalence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current operation definition has match 0..* and nested relationship, concept, property, product, dependsOn, and originMap parts; source/conceptmap/$translate-response.txt includes a successful response with two match outputs. Searches found no current obsolete outcome parameter and no later requirement for a match.message part.
